record_scope_reconstruction: Desaguadero renewed January bridge blockade and March negotiated weekly-access regime remain separate observations. The old urban bridge and new Carancas freight bridge must not be conflated.

source_checks.finding: Fides 4 January describes renewed dawn blockade affecting vehicles and people after December truce.
RPP 23 March names Carancas international and pedestrian bridges, with access to Monday then Tuesday/Wednesday strike; inland approaches still affected.
23 March local account corroborates five-day flexibility and Tuesday/Wednesday stoppage; teacher access to Juli road separately restricted.
